messages:
Emily G.: Hey team — HarmoniaAI just sent their final logos and the customer quote for the case study. Need a quick check on lockup versions, clearspace, and the quote wording. Files here: <https://files.redwood.ai/harmonia/Harmonia_logos_v5.zip> :point_down:
Samir K.: grabbing files now. Quick flag: primary logo looks too tight on the left when paired with our wordmark. I can try a lockup with more clearspace. Also pls ask for SVGs with outlined shapes (no embedded fonts).
Aisha P.: thanks. On the quote they gave: "Redwood made inference 3x cheaper and easier to deploy." We should confirm the "3x" claim with metrics or offer a softened alternative like "significantly reduced inference costs." Also need customer permission to use name/quote.
Jordan L.: Legal here — please get explicit customer permission for attribution. Also send Harmonia's brand guidelines and trademark phrasing. We'll need a line like: "HarmoniaAI® is a registered trademark of Harmonia Labs." — confirm with partner.
Samir K.: Uploaded a quick mock: `harmonia_redwood_lockup_v2.svg` — using 16px clearspace rule and slightly larger icon. Suggest moving Harmonia mark 8px left for visual balance. Will export marketplace tile sizes once we have legal ok (1:1, 16:9, and 4:1 hero).
AssetBot: uploaded files to channel — harmonia_redwood_lockup_v2.svg, harmonia_logo_guidelines.pdf, and marketplace_tiles.zip. Links: https://assets.redwood.ai/harmonia/harmonia_redwood_lockup_v2.svg, https://assets.redwood.ai/harmonia/harmonia_logo_guidelines.pdf
Emily G.: Thanks — @Jordan L. can you confirm the trademark wording and whether the customer quote needs fact-checking? @Aisha P. can you draft softened quote options and the permission request template by EOD? If yes, I'll slot the assets into the marketplace draft and ping Harmonia for final sign-off. :calendar:
